class.name: HTMLRenderTarget
class.brief_description: Node that renders an HTML/CSS document to a reusable texture.
class.description: Produces a [Texture2D] from an [HTMLDocument] without drawing it directly.

signal.name: rendered
signal.description: Emitted after [method render_now] updates the texture.

signal.name: texture_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the output texture content changes.

method.name: get_image
method.description: Returns the latest CPU image for tests, export tooling, and headless rendering paths.

method.name: get_form_control_state
method.description: Returns the latest state for a form control in the live document, or an empty [Dictionary] when no control with [param id] is available.

method.name: set_element_attribute
method.description: Sets an attribute on an element in the live rendered document without reloading the document. Inline event handlers and [code]javascript:[/code] URL surfaces are rejected by the no-script profile.

method.name: remove_element_attribute
method.description: Removes an attribute from an element in the live rendered document without reloading the document.

method.name: set_element_style
method.description: Replaces the element's inline [code]style[/code] attribute in the live rendered document without reloading the document.

method.name: set_element_text
method.description: Replaces the text content of an element in the live rendered document without reloading the document.

method.name: set_element_inner_html
method.description: Replaces the inner HTML of an element in the live rendered document without reloading the document. Unsafe fragments are rejected by the no-script profile.

method.name: set_body_inner_html
method.description: Replaces the inner HTML of the live document body without reloading the document. Unsafe fragments are rejected by the no-script profile.

method.name: set_form_control_value
method.description: Sets the live value of a text-like form control without reloading the document.

method.name: set_form_control_checked
method.description: Sets the live checked state of a checkbox or radio control using Blink form-control semantics.

method.name: focus_element
method.description: Moves live document focus to the element with [param id].

method.name: blur_focused_element
method.description: Blurs the currently focused element in the live document.

method.name: set_text_selection
method.description: Sets the selection or caret range for a text-like form control in the live document.

method.name: replace_stylesheet_text
method.description: Replaces the text of a [code]<style>[/code] element in the live rendered document without reloading the document.
